info.title: HomeHub API
info.description: Token-protected JSON API for HomeHub. Send the token as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". Create tokens in HomeHub under Admin tools, API access, or with "flask api-token create". See docs/api.md for examples.

get.description: What this token can do: its name, whether it may act as family members or delete, the tools it can use with their level (read or write), and the family members it can act as. Call this first.

400.description: The request is not valid (unknown field, wrong type, bad date, ...).

403.description: The token has no access to this tool or level, or may not act as that person.

404.description: Not found, or the tool is switched off in config.yml.

get.description: Every family member's Who is home status: home, away (the web app can also set out or traveling), or null when not set.

400.description: The request is not valid (unknown field, wrong type, bad date, ...).

403.description: The token has no access to this tool or level, or may not act as that person.

404.description: Not found, or the tool is switched off in config.yml.

put.description: Set a family member Home or Away, for example from a Home Assistant zone automation. The name is matched without regard to case. Needs a token that can act as family members.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The family member, for example Priya.

by.description: The family member this change is made for: the name of the person who asked. Only accepted when the token may act as family members. Without it the token name is used.

200.description: The result as JSON. Changes include a short "summary" sentence to confirm back.

400.description: The request is not valid (unknown field, wrong type, bad date, ...).

403.description: The token has no access to this tool or level, or may not act as that person.

404.description: Not found, or the tool is switched off in config.yml.
